2. Heard learned Advocate for the Applicant and learned APP for the Respondent - State.
3. Rule.

Learned APP waives service of notice for and on behalf of the respondent - State.
4. Learned Advocate for the Petitioner has submitted that the matter has been amicably settled between the parties and they are now not willing to proceed with the complaint any further.

sentences.text: Leaned Advocate Mr. Vaibhav Desai has submitted that he has received instructions to appear on behalf of the complainant and he may be permitted to file his Vakalatnama before the Registry.
He has referred the Affidavit dated 29.08.2025.
Learned Advocate has submitted that matter has been amicably settled between the parties and there is no objection if present application is allowed.

The relevant part of the affidavit reads thus:
"I the deponent and the present petitioner herein jointly requesting this Hon'ble Court to quash impugned F.I.R. and further proceedings there into.

I say that I have no objection if the F.I.R. at Annexure-A registered with Vapi Town Police Station,
Dist- Valsad vide C.R.No.11200048250852 of 2025 under Section 376(1), 376(2)(n)
and 500 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and subsequent proceedings of the Sessions Case No.26 of 2025 pending before the 2nd Additional District & Sessions Court,
Valsad at Vapi is quashed and prayer made by the petitioner in the present petition is granted by this Hon'ble Court.

sentences.text: I have decided to compromise with the petitioner and neither I have been threatened not enticed by any person including the accused for compromise."
6. Considering averments made in the Affidavit as also the submissions made by the learned Advocates for the respective parties, the present Application deserves to be allowed and is hereby allowed.

The FIR being CR No.11200048250852 of 2025 registered with Vapi Town Police Station,
Valsad is hereby quashed and set aside.
